services.name: Drop-in Classes
services.desc: Whether you are a beginner or an experienced actor, these drop-in classes are the best place to start your Lucid Body journey. Come visit the House, meet our teachers and enjoy discussion with other members of the Lucid Body community. The Lucid Body is a hands-on technique for the actor striving for authenticity. While this process is rewarding both for self-growth and for greater acting control, it is a challenging one. Our drop-in acting classes in NYC are a once a week introduction to the Lucid Body process and community. Each drop-in class includes our legendary warm-up and core concepts to prepare you for the next steps in your Lucid Body journey. The drop-in is designed for anyone

services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: The Lucid Body Teacher Training is an apprenticeship program, in which a maximum of eight hand-selected apprentices will be chosen by Fay Simspon to become the next generation of certified Lucid Body instructors. Each apprentice works closely with Fay Simpson and Lucid Body Institute faculty, and attends five in-person group teacher training intensive modules. These modules will provide a foundation for learning how to teach the Lucid Body process and offer tools and resources to become a skilled Lucid Body teacher. Apprentices will learn how to instruct the Lucid Body Warm Up, plus Lucid Body Basics Level 1 & 2 exercises. The apprentice will assist and observe Lucid Body workshops,
